title: Generate the hand-mirrored contract numbers; sync tests pin the door
deviations_from_card: Critic revision applied: 11 constants, not 13 - app/_lib/fit-thresholds.ts and test_fit_threshold_sync.py untouched (FIT floors stay pinned by the existing extractor). Python cites re-verified: automation.py:2323 MAX_SCORECARD_NOTES_CHARS, :1447-1450 KIT_MAX_*, :1808 LETTER_MAX_CHARS, POLICY dict keys at :162-163 (the table supports py_key for dict lookup), calibration_drift.py:40-41, devcase/design.py:98. No aging-policy constant among them. Write set grew by one source-guard test the brief allows re-pointing: pipeline/jobfit/tests/test_scorecard_notes_sampling.py read the TS literal for MAX_SCORECARD_NOTES_CHARS; it now reads the generated file and refuses a literal in the home. The TS homes import './contract-constants.generated.ts' WITH the extension: a plain extensionless import broke app/_lib/erasure-full-scrub.test.ts, whose hand-rolled resolve hook treats '.generated' as an existing extension (caught by the full test:unit). Tests + impl landed in ONE feat commit (the tests are red without the implementation, and each commit had to be green), not a separate test commit. Plus perf-budget.json under the lock (+1 module per graph) and api-contracts.md section 2.3.
notes: Red-before measured by running the new/re-pointed tests against the base codegen.py: 10 test methods failed, mapping to acceptance cases 1-6 and 8 red; case 7 (the behavioural non-vacuity probes) was green before by design. Import cost: the new generated module adds +1 module to app/page.tsx and 12 API route graphs (+1-2 KB) - measured on git-archive trees HEAD vs HEAD~1; each ceiling raised by that share only (7c08b93ba), app/api/tasks/history/route.ts got a named override. test:perf exit 1 on the committed tree is NOT this card: app/page.tsx is 8917 KB vs ceiling 8913 and the extra 4 KB was already over at f12e9a531 (profile-roster-matrix, committed before me); in the working tree further KB overages come from siblings' uncommitted files. tsc whole-tree errors seen only under the untracked kpi-sim/ directory (foreign) and, transiently, ProfileRosterRefreshBar.tsx (sibling in flight, cleared on re-run). Left as-is (outside write set): Python-side comments that still say 'hand-mirrored into' the TS files - automation.py:159, :1443, :1805, :2320, calibration_drift.py:39, devcase/design.py:95 - and the node-side schemas-gen.mjs hint that lists only two generated files. npm run typecheck ran once (schemas:gen regenerates the committed contract file byte-identically; codegen --check exit 0).
